source.title: Comprehensive human locomotion and electromyography dataset: Gait120
source.evidence_access: Reconciled against all relevant sections of the locally extracted ten-page PDF; source hash retained.
source.location: Figure 4 caption; Methods; Motion capture data; Comparison of joint kinematics with public dataset

supported_angle_mapping.knee_flexion: Source positive extension; negate for canonical flexion.
supported_angle_mapping.scope: Figure4 describes right-limb kinematics. These statements support current sagittal mapping, not every converted value or an independently checked left-side model.

force_provenance.missing_reason: Source paper reports force-plate/motion-capture coordinate misalignment for first ten participants; retain missingness.

protocol_metadata_supported.speed: Self-selected; reported population mean must not become recording speed.

remaining_gates: Exact modified model and original setup provenance, including left-side coordinate conventions.
Despite documented global axes, per-recording plate-to-foot assignment and conversion to an anatomical local frame remain unverified.
Moment-arm units are documented, but ankle-relative COP and free-torque reference conventions are not established.
Derived segment orientations require model/frame evidence; scalar angle sums are insufficient.
Independent full-output source comparisons and complete exclusion accounting remain required.
current_implementation: Default reconstruction keeps experimental inverse dynamics disabled, raw plate channels retained and canonical anatomical force/COP missing. No source or queued code changed.
possible_isolated_followup: Add paper-supported terrain/stool metadata with explicit protocol provenance; retain self-selected speed as unknown per recording.

source_model_and_methods.reported_model: Modified Rajagopal model, with one knee rotational degree of freedom; OpenSim4.0 inverse kinematics.
source_model_and_methods.reported_angle_rotation_order: Z, X, Y for flexion/extension, adduction/abduction, internal/external rotation. This documents the authors convention; it does not establish the exact modified XML or validate segment-angle sums.

segmentation.level_walking: Right heel-strike at vertical GRF upward crossing20N; toe-off at downward crossing20N.
segmentation.locomotion_observation: Right heel-strike to next right heel-strike.
segmentation.stool_transfers: Pelvis/shoulder marker-defined start/end; one complete transfer.

data_and_code_availability.limitation: The code-availability section lists EMG processing and visualization scripts, not the exact modified musculoskeletal model or IK setup. This is not proof those artifacts are absent from every external location.

header_example.scope: One source header only; no data rows loaded

publisher_knee_mapping.interpretation: Selected knee source column is negated before labeling plot Knee Flexion; corroborates source paper right-knee convention

publisher_code_review.scope: Bounded publisher archive inspection and one local MOT header; no numerical source values loaded
publisher_code_review.conclusion: Publisher plotting code independently corroborates right-knee negation for flexion. Archive contains processing and visualization scripts, not the modified musculoskeletal model.

protocol_metadata_proposal.scope: Adds only documented apparatus dimensions and field-specific DOI/page evidence; numerical functions unchanged; speed remains absent
protocol_metadata_proposal.remaining: Integrate in new immutable conversion or metadata correction and verify persisted outputs before adoption
